verdict.rationale: Elastic's marketing pages say users can interact with telemetry in natural language, and that an AI SRE (nightshift) investigates incidents and delivers evidence-backed root cause. The docs also mention anomaly detection and log categorization. These are only short claims, with no in-depth docs on how the AI insights or suggestions work inside the product and no hands-on corroboration, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the in-product AI assistant/insight features, evidence of actionable suggestions (not just root-cause findings), independent or hands-on validation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
detect patterns and outliers with categorization and anomaly detection
